about: Requests the AWS SDK for Python (botocore 1.42.46, the library inside the aws command line) builds for each operation, signed with the placeholder key and captured before sending; `fixed` is the same request signed by the SDK with an example key, session token and time (with its own body where the SDK generated a different idempotency token).
